catalog.title: YinYangYoHackers Cybersecurity & Autonomous Systems Catalog
catalog.description: Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) manifest declaring browser-native zero-telemetry cybersecurity tools, cryptanalysis utilities, network diagnostics, and sovereign autonomous computing blueprints.

entries.description: Browser-native IPv4 and IPv6 Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) subnet calculator. Calculates network ranges, usable addresses, netmasks, broadcast addresses, and wildcard masks without external API calls.
representativeQueries: calculate IPv4 subnet mask for CIDR /24
find usable host addresses in 10.0.0.0/16 prefix
convert CIDR notation to dotted decimal subnet mask
calculate network address and broadcast address for IP

entries.description: Client-side cryptographic hash calculator, identifier, and integrity verifier. Computes SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-384, SHA-1, and MD5 hashes using Web Crypto API.
representativeQueries: generate SHA-256 checksum for verification string
identify cryptographic hash algorithm from signature length
verify file or payload integrity against known hash
compute SHA-512 cryptographic digest

entries.displayName: Password Entropy & Brute-Force Crack Time Calculator
entries.description: Calculates Shannon password entropy in bits, total keyspace search complexity, and estimated brute-force crack time against modern GPU clusters and supercomputers according to NIST SP 800-63B guidelines.
representativeQueries: calculate Shannon entropy in bits for password
estimate brute-force crack time on RTX 4090 cluster
verify NIST SP 800-63B password strength compliance
check password keyspace and character pool complexity

entries.description: Interactive generator and analyzer for hardened HTTP response headers (Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Frame-Options, Permissions-Policy) across Nginx, Apache, Caddy, Cloudflare, and Express.
representativeQueries: generate hardened Content-Security-Policy header
configure Strict-Transport-Security HSTS preload rule
generate Nginx security headers configuration block
audit X-Frame-Options and MIME sniffing mitigations

entries.description: Audits SSL/TLS certificate chains, protocol version support (TLS 1.3 / TLS 1.2), forward secrecy cipher suites, certificate validity dates, and outputs reproducible OpenSSL CLI diagnostic commands.
representativeQueries: inspect SSL certificate expiration date and issuer
verify TLS 1.3 forward secrecy cipher suites
generate OpenSSL s_client diagnostic command
audit HTTPS transport layer certificate validity

entries.description: Adversarial prompt injection testing sandbox. Evaluates LLM input sanitization, jailbreak pattern detection, system prompt extraction resistance, and OWASP Top 10 for LLM mitigations.
representativeQueries: test LLM prompt against indirect prompt injection
simulate adversarial jailbreak heuristics on system prompt
audit input sanitization filters for autonomous agent workflows
verify model prompt leakage resilience

entries.description: Browser-native CyberChef-style payload transformer. Encodes and decodes multi-layer payloads across Base64, Hexadecimal, URL encoding, Binary, HTML entities, and ROT13.
representativeQueries: decode multi-layer Base64 and Hex string
convert binary bitstream to ASCII text
URL encode payload for web exploitation simulation
transform payload with ROT13 and HTML entity encoding

entries.description: Zero-telemetry IP reconnaissance tool. Queries Autonomous System Numbers (ASN), ISP network operators, CIDR allocation blocks, and geographic telemetry with interactive coordinates.
representativeQueries: lookup Autonomous System Number ASN for IP address
find ISP and network routing organization for host
verify CIDR prefix allocation and geographic origin of IP
inspect IP address routing telemetry

entries.description: Technical blueprints for enterprise self-hosted model execution: Ollama systemd sandboxing, vLLM distributed cluster hardening, air-gapped optical data diodes, and PyTorch SafeTensors verification.
representativeQueries: deploy private Ollama daemon with mTLS and systemd isolation
configure air-gapped language models with optical data diodes
mitigate PyTorch pickle deserialization remote code execution
harden local vLLM cluster against KV-cache DoS
